rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Terminal Controller is an MCP server that enables secure terminal command execution, directory navigation, and file system operations through a standardized interface. It implements several tools for executing commands, managing directories, and tracking command history, with built-in security measures to prevent dangerous operations. The server is designed to work across Windows and UNIX-based systems, making it versatile for various terminal-based tasks and integrations with AI-assisted workflows.
